about_the_game:
A set of DLC-exclusive mascots inspired by the adventures on Balduq. Mascots can be displayed anywhere onscreen.

Balduq: Adol
Balduq: Red King
Balduq: White Cat
Balduq: Hawk
Balduq: Doll
Balduq: Bull
Balduq: Apostate
Balduq: Aprilis

*Open [DLC] under [Items] in the main menu and select new items to receive them.
*After receiving items, place mascots via [Items] -> [Used Items] in the main menu.
